headline: Data center power demand surges, driving infrastructure stocks
summary: A prominent tech CEO's comments regarding extreme power scarcity for data centers sent a cluster of AI infrastructure stocks surging past the broader market.
why: Artificial intelligence data centers require massive amounts of electrical power, creating unique opportunities and challenges for energy and digital infrastructure providers.

impacts.name: Digital Infrastructure
impacts.why: Heightened recognition of power scarcity highlights the critical bottleneck and value of operational data center power supplies.

why_moved: Comments emphasizing robust, unyielding power demand for artificial intelligence applications reassured investors about the growth trajectory of data center operators.
